system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "STABILITY trial of darapladib failed to reduce MACE in stable coronary heart disease (HR 0.94, p=0.199), consistent with a non-causal Lp-PLA2 target.", "summary": "The STABILITY trial randomized 15,828 patients with stable coronary heart disease to darapladib 160 mg or placebo, targeting a 15.5% relative risk reduction with 90% power and 1,500 planned primary endpoint events over a median 3.51 years follow-up. The trial did not meet its primary endpoint of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke (HR 0.94, p=0.199). Genetic evidence shows no causal link between PLA2G7 and coronary heart disease (Open Targets score 0.0), and the calculator predicts no benefit (expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0%). Safety was acceptable with no major imbalance in serious adverse events. Confidence in the failure assessment is medium, limited by the calculator's internal inconsistency on target genetics classification.", "key_evidence": ["15,828 participants randomized (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Primary endpoint: composite of CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "1,500 planned primary endpoint events (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "90% power, 15.5% assumed RRR (Study design and rationale for the clinical outcomes of the STABILITY Trial)", "Median follow-up 3.51 years (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00799903 STABILITY)", "Observed HR 0.94, p=0.199 (GSK announces top-line results from pivotal Phase III study of darapladib in chronic coronary heart disease)", "Lp-PLA2 inhibition 49-67% in phase 2 studies (Effect of darapladib on plasma lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 activity in Japanese dyslipidemic patients; The effect of darapladib on plasma lipoprotein-associated phospholipase A2 activity and cardiovascular biomarkers in patients with stable coronary heart disease)", "PLA2G7 genetic association score 0.0 (opentargets:PLA2G7)", "Calculator expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0.0% (calculator)"], "what_would_change_this": "A positive Mendelian randomization study showing PLA2G7 variants associate with reduced CHD risk, or a trial in a population with confirmed high Lp-PLA2 activity and genetic evidence of causality, would be needed to overturn the conclusion that Lp-PLA2 inhibition is not a valid cardiovascular target.", "readthrough_note": "The SOLID-TIMI 52 trial in acute coronary syndrome (NCT01000727) also failed, reinforcing that darapladib does not reduce cardiovascular events across different coronary populations. No other Lp-PLA2 inhibitor programmes are known to be active."}
